name: Reminders
description: Remind me later about this workspace or tab: a desktop notification when it is due, a count in the status bar, and snooze, move, open or tick off from a sidebar panel or the palette.

cover.alt: The Reminders panel beside a workspace in Orca: a due reminder with Done, Snooze and Open buttons, the add form, and the pending list.
